cases.description: The client's WordPress administrator can log in and use the dashboard.
Required navigation links lead to the intended working pages.
Critical navigation and forms are usable with keyboard focus and labels.
Required pages have no unintended horizontal overflow or inaccessible controls at required and stress viewports.
No unfinished sections, broken required images, dead controls or draft client content remain.
The exact export restores on a fresh hostname and passes its required checks.
The client can create/edit simple and variable products, categories, images, prices and stock, and observe storefront updates.
A real product can enter the cart and complete a controlled test order using isolated integrations.
The resulting order and stock persist and are manageable in WordPress administration.
Unavailable products, configured shipping/gateway results and required address/phone cases behave correctly.
